result: ARM64 image build, current-source schema replay, migration-plan parity, logical restore, spatial/raster functions, health, protected-route rejection, and short restart recovery passed under emulation.
limitations: This is QEMU/emulator evidence, not Raspberry Pi hardware evidence or a 4 GB device benchmark.
